description.value: M & J's Country Kitchen is a home-style country restaurant in Oliver Place Mall, Oliver, BC, opened in March 2020 by local couple Matt and Jennifer Hartle. It has earned multiple consecutive 'Best of South Okanagan' awards covering burgers, breakfast/brunch, desserts, wings, and family dining. The restaurant sources locally — coffee from Oliver's Wolf Tree Coffee Co. and fresh bread from Big Al's Bakery — and runs a community 'Pay it Forward' board to provide meals for those in need.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and detailed. The menu subpage confirms the full address as '1240-5955 Main St, Oliver, BC V0H 1T0 Oliver Place Mall', which is more complete than the OSM 'addr:street: Ol' entry (though the unit '1240' and house number '5955' match). Phone 250-485-4920 is confirmed on the website contact section. Gluten-free options are explicitly confirmed with a no-cross-contamination claim; bike parking, washrooms, and most other amenities are not mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM addr:street is truncated as 'Ol' — full address from website is '1240-5955 Main St, Oliver, BC V0H 1T0'; OSM record should be corrected.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating licensed restaurant with an active website, confirmed physical address in Oliver Place Mall, and multiple community awards.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states: 'GLUTEN FREE: having a child in our family that is Celiac, we understand the need to provide gluten free options. Our "GF" noted on the menu is 100% with no cross-contamination. Talk to your server about additional choices.'

wow_evidence: multiple consecutive 'Best of South Okanagan' awards
